description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Teemo''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed after 5 seconds without taking non-[[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|over time]] damage from enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] or [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turrets]].
description.text: Passive: Teemo gains  bonus movement speed after 5 seconds without taking non- over time damage from enemy champions or turrets.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Teemo''' doubles the '''bonus''' movement speed for 3 seconds, preventing it from being removed for the duration.
description2.text: Active: Teemo doubles the bonus movement speed for 3 seconds, preventing it from being removed for the duration.

description3.raw: ''Casting Move Quick does not interrupt [[File:Teemo Guerrilla Warfare.png|20xpx|border|link=Teemo#Guerrilla Warfare|An icon for Teemo's ability Guerrilla Warfare]] [[Teemo#Guerrilla Warfare|Guerrilla Warfare]].''
description3.text: Casting Move Quick does not interrupt Guerrilla Warfare.

leveling2.raw:
'''Enhanced Bonus Movement Speed:'''
24 / 32 / 40 / 48 / 56%

notes.raw: * When ''Move Quick's'' active bonus movement speed ends '''Teemo''' will not regain the passive one if he was damaged during the active's duration. *''Move Quick's'' passive will be disabled even if the damage is blocked with a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]].
notes.text:
When Move Quick's active bonus movement speed ends Teemo will not regain the passive one if he was damaged during the active's duration.
Move Quick's passive will be disabled even if the damage is blocked with a spell shield.
